title: Chain Loading Utilities
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of functions for dynamically loading and constructing various types of LangChain chains from configuration dictionaries or file paths. It also includes helper functions for creating specific QA and summarization chains.

nodes.label: Load LLMCheckerChain
nodes.title: Load LLMCheckerChain
